offering_description.value: Badger Meter supplies water measurement and monitoring technology, software, and services to municipal utilities and commercial and industrial customers. It integrates field measurements with software for continuous water management.

quotes.quote: Badger Meter provides comprehensive water management solutions that connect measurement, monitoring and data across municipal, commercial and industrial applications.

Our suite of scalable solutions integrates water technology, software and services for continuous water management. BlueEdge gives you the advantage to intelligently drive visibility and optimization across assets, people and processes, delivering the future of water management.

primary_products.value: water and flow meters; water quality, pressure and gas monitoring instruments; valves; communications endpoints; water management software

quotes.quote: Our highly accurate and reliable meters, sensors, monitors and valves provide precise monitoring of your entire water system. Improve your understanding of system performance so that you can take action to capture revenue, reduce costs, mitigate risk, improve customer satisfaction, optimize assets and enhance sustainability.
